# Prairie Home Cleaning

> House cleaning company based in Naperville, Illinois. Serves Naperville, Aurora, Wheaton, Lisle, Downers Grove, Bolingbrook, Plainfield, Oswego. Published prices, online price calculator and online booking.

- Phone: (630) 555-0142
- Email: hello@example.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8 am to 5 pm; Saturday 9 am to 2 pm
- Prices (3-bed, 2-bath, about 1,800 sq ft): standard $220 to $255, deep $355 to $410, move-in/move-out $410 to $475.
- Recurring discounts on standard cleans: weekly 20%, every 2 weeks 15%, every 4 weeks 10%.
- Supplies: the team brings all supplies and equipment.
- Policies: Reschedule or cancel up to 48 hours before your arrival window at no charge. Inside 48 hours we charge a $50 fee. We charge your card after the cleaning is done. No deposit to book.

## Pages

- [Price calculator and booking](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/quote/): exact price for a home by bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet, condition, frequency and add-ons
- [Pricing](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/pricing/): full price table, pricing formula, add-ons and discounts
- [Cleaning checklist](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/checklist/): room-by-room tasks for standard, deep and move cleans
- [Standard cleaning](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/services/standard-cleaning/): Kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas, top to bottom. For homes that get cleaned regularly.
- [Deep cleaning](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/services/deep-cleaning/): Everything in a standard clean plus baseboards, grout, vents, the range hood and the buildup in corners.
- [Move-in and move-out cleaning](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/services/move-out-cleaning/): For empty homes. Inside cabinets, closets, the oven and the fridge, plus everything in a deep clean.
- [Weekly and biweekly cleaning](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/services/recurring-cleaning/): A standard clean on a schedule. Weekly saves 20%, every two weeks 15%, every four weeks 10%.
- [Service areas](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/areas/): Naperville, Aurora, Wheaton, Lisle, Downers Grove, Bolingbrook, Plainfield, Oswego
- [FAQ](https://samirawad24.github.io/il-house-cleaning/faq/)
